Class ExtensionBlockParser

java.lang.Object
tech.kwik.agent15.extension.ExtensionBlockParser
public class ExtensionBlockParser extends Object
Parses the block of extensions that a handshake message carries: the two-byte length field followed by the sequence of extensions. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8446#section-4.2

    • parseExtensionHeader

      public static int parseExtensionHeader(ByteBuffer buffer, int expectedType, int minimumExtensionSize) throws DecodeErrorException
      Parses the header (type and length) of a single extension, for extension types that are not defined by TlsConstants.ExtensionType (e.g. the QUIC transport parameters extension).
      Parameters:
      buffer -
      expectedType - the type the extension is expected to have; a mismatch indicates a programming error
      minimumExtensionSize - the minimum size of the extension data
      Returns:
      the length of the extension data
      Throws:
      DecodeErrorException - when the extension is malformed

    • findPositionLastExtension

      public static int findPositionLastExtension(ByteBuffer buffer)
      Returns the (relative) position of the last extension.
      Parameters:
      buffer - data to parse, buffer position should be at the point where extensions start. on return, the buffer position will be right after the last extension.
      Returns:
      the start position of the last extension, relative to the start of all extensions.
